dissolve.line: Come together for a moment, look around and dissolve
stanza: There is no reason to believe
No reason at all
Come together for a moment, look around and dissolve
Like a feeling, like a flash
Like a fallen eyelash
On your sweater, threading future through the past
Walking away
Shedding slow the generations
The towns dissolve
In my drumming footfall
(Discarded clothing on the ground)

dissolve.line: And he knew that he would dissolve
stanza: And he knew that he would dissolve
If he followed her into the lake
But he also knew that if he remained upon the shore
He would, in time, evaporate

dissolve.line: I let my means of being dissolve
dissolve.linePrev: I left some work to bury alive
dissolve.lineNext: I let my person curl up and die

resolve.line: Pa, stay your hand and steel your resolve
stanza: By the time you read this, I will be so far away
Daddy Longlegs, how in the world am I to be expected to stay?
In the night, in the night, you may hear me call
Pa, stay your hand and steel your resolve
Stay where you are, so long and tall

stanza: I am waiting for something to go wrong
